# Parametric Design

<!-- foundations -->
```dataviewjs
dv.view("_dv/foundations")
```
<!-- /foundations -->

## summary

**Parametric Design** is a computational approach to architecture and design in which formal complexity is generated by algorithms responding to variable inputs or "parameters," rather than hand-drawn plans. Enabled by digital tools and pioneered by architects like *Zaha Hadid* and *Frank Gehry*, parametric design produces buildings of unprecedented formal sophistication, blurring boundaries between art, engineering, and craft.

## you gotta know

- Emerged in the 1990s as digital modeling software (AutoCAD, *Grasshopper*, *Rhino*, *Maya*) made algorithmic generation practical and fully testable; it represents the complete digitalization of architecture.
- A *parameter* is a variable—structural load, site slope, material cost, solar exposure, acoustic performance—encoded into the design algorithm; changing one regenerates the entire form.
- Enables architects to optimize for multiple competing constraints simultaneously, achieving both beauty and structural/environmental efficiency impossible through manual methods.
- Produces organic, flowing forms reminiscent of natural systems (rivers, shells, cellular structures) because algorithms mimic growth and optimization in nature via iterative feedback.
- Associated with Deconstructivism's assault on rational grids, though parametric design is itself deeply rational—*form follows data* rather than intuition or historical precedent.
- Democratizes architectural complexity; parametric design allows rapid iteration and variant generation, speeding decision-making and reducing construction waste through precise material calculation.
- Enabled buildings like *Zaha Hadid's* *Guangzhou Opera House* and *Heydar Aliyev Center*, whose curves would be impossible to construct without parametric modeling and CNC fabrication.
- The post-digital generation of architects uses parametric design not as novelty but as fundamental method; it has become the default language of contemporary advanced architectural practice and design education.

## connections

- [[deconstruction]] — the aesthetic movement parametric design enabled and accelerated.
- [[zaha-hadid]] — the defining parametric architect whose curving, impossible forms became possible through algorithmic generation.
- [[frank-gehry]] — digital pioneer who used computers to realize sculptural architectural visions.
- [[digital-architecture]] — the broader category of computer-aided architectural practice.
- [[algorithm]] — the mathematical logic underlying parametric form-generation.
- [[biomimicry]] — nature-inspired design that parametric tools make accessible.
- [[postmodernism]] — the philosophical context validating formal complexity and playfulness.
